outcome: Maternal co-morbidities (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, primary cesarean delivery)

Adverse perinatal outcomes (neonatal demise, preterm birth, intrauterine growth restriction, macrosomia, fetal demise, asphyxia, respiratory distress syndrome, jaundice, intraventricular hemorrhage, hypoglycemia, necrotizing enterocolitis)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies at ≥20 weeks' gestation in California from 2005-2008
finding: Mothers with cystic fibrosis are more likely to have pre-gestational diabetes, deliver preterm, and have a primary cesarean delivery, while their infants are more likely to have congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: Mothers with cystic fibrosis had higher rates of primary cesarean delivery.
